mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ncs_prg_aply (prg_id, std_id, aply_dt, aply_stat_cd, aply_code) VALUES (#{prgId}, #{stdId}, now(), #{aplyStatCd}, #{aplyCode})
mapper.select: SELECT p.prg_id, p.prg_nm, p.prg_st_dt, p.prg_end_dt, ci.cci_nm AS category_name, a.aply_id, a.aply_dt, a.aply_stat_cd, c.cmp_stat_cd FROM public.ncs_prg_aply a JOIN public.ncs_prg_info p ON a.prg_id = p.prg_id JOIN public.core_cpt_info ci ON p.cci_id = ci.cci_id LEFT JOIN public.ncs_cmp_info c ON a.aply_id = c.aply_id WHERE a.std_id = 34 ORDER BY a.aply_dt DESC
